title: Unit 1 Overview: Key Expressions and Vocabulary List
summary: A list of key sentences and vocabulary items from Unit 1, covering health problems, injuries, habits like smoking and exercise, and expressions about how life has changed over time.

title: Lesson 1: Identifying Minor Health Problems from Pictures and Descriptions
summary: An activity where students look at pictures of people with health issues, match spoken complaints to correct images, and then complete exercises in the Activity Book covering injuries, symptoms, and causes.

title: Lesson 2: Doctor–Patient Dialogue about a Fractured Wrist Injury
summary: Students examine a picture of a doctor's visit, read a dialogue about an ice-skating fall and a fractured wrist, guess missing words, then listen to confirm their answers before completing Activity Book exercises.

title: Lesson 3: Ammar's Blog Post about a Diving Accident and Recovery
summary: A reading task based on Ammar's blog about a serious back injury from diving into a shallow river, his physical therapy journey, and the impact of health technology on his recovery, with a multiple-choice title question.

title: Lesson 4: Reading About Smoking Statistics and Phrasal Verb Usage
summary: A gap-fill reading exercise with facts about smoking and vaping in the UK, using specific figures, followed by a language box explaining how phrasal verbs are formed from verbs and prepositions.

title: Lesson 5: Top Tips for Keeping Healthy — Matching Advice to Recommendations
summary: Students complete ten health tips by selecting appropriate phrases, then match four of the tips with photos, followed by Activity Book exercises reinforcing healthy lifestyle advice.

title: Lesson 6: Using 'Used to' to Talk About How Life Has Changed in Iraq
summary: A grammar lesson on the structure 'used to / didn't use to' with photo captions about past life in Iraq, opinion statements for discussion, and guided speaking about changes over the past 100 years.

title: Lesson 7: Linking Words and Phrases in a Text about Unhealthy Lifestyles
summary: An activity where students choose correct linking words to complete an article about government spending on healthcare caused by poor diet and lack of exercise, with a reference box of useful connecting phrases.
